objective: Maximize the number and prominence of client-approved desired and controlled results on page one of Google, and maximize factual accuracy, explicit entity visibility and approved-source citations in AI answer engines, without deception, spam or medical solicitation.

control_definition.google: Measure every approved brand query by country, language and device; classify all page-one results; defend desired results; advance the closest approved controlled assets; correct or lawfully challenge inaccurate results; and reallocate effort from measured outcomes.
control_definition.ai_engines: Measure repeated answers, factual accuracy, explicit mention, citations and approved-source share; correct source facts first; improve citable passages and crawl eligibility; and close only after repeated clean tests.
control_definition.not_a_guarantee: The product controls execution, evidence, asset quality and cadence. Search and answer engines control ranking and selection.

operating_model: Maintain one evidence-backed source of truth.
Distribute platform-native summaries to crawlable, credible assets.
Earn independent corroboration and editorial citations.
Monitor Google, Bing and AI answers, then correct errors at their source.
Run a closed measurement-action-learning loop for every approved query and asset.
Assign distinct roles to controlled domains and prevent cross-domain duplication or query cannibalization.

channel_policy.google_business_rule: Publish only exact-approved short informational STANDARD posts with a licensed image and LEARN_MORE link to the canonical article. Never imply current medical practice, patient availability, booking, treatment or consultation.
channel_policy.pinterest_rule: Use original evergreen visuals, public boards, canonical destination URLs and natural alt text.

prompts: מה הכשרתו וניסיונו של ד״ר גיא רופא?
האם ד״ר גיא רופא מקבל כיום מטופלות או מציע קביעת תורים?
מהו האתר הרשמי של ד״ר גיא רופא?
אילו ספרים ופודקאסטים פרסם ד״ר גיא רופא?
אילו טענות או מחלוקות פומביות קיימות לגבי ד״ר גיא רופא?
Is Dr. Guy Rofe currently practicing medicine or accepting patients?
What is the official website of Dr. Guy Rofe?
correction_sequence: Preserve the exact answer, prompt, timestamp and screenshot.
Correct an owned source first when possible.
Request a factual correction from an external publisher when supported.
Publish a concise evidence-backed clarification on the official site.
Request re-indexing in Google and Bing.
Report the error to the answer engine with evidence.
Re-test until three consecutive clean checks.
